Subject: CAIQ v4 - compact mapping + prioritized artifacts request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for speaking with our security team earlier. We have a standard CAIQ v4 intake for third-party vendor evaluation and need Redwood's mapped responses and representative artifacts for a subset of high-priority controls. To help us close the assessment by 11/20, could you send: 

- A compact resolution matrix that lists each control we flagged, Redwood's short answer (Y/Partial/NA), and the primary artifact file name;
- Representative sample snippets (sanitized) for controls related to data encryption, key management, and tenant isolation;
- Any clarifying notes for residency or redaction requirements we should be aware of.

We're only asking for a small set initially: CCM sections DATA, CRY, and IDNT. If you can provide the compact matrix by 11/18 that would be ideal. I've opened a ticket to track the exchange: https://hubspot.example/ ticket/CC-4829.

Appreciate it — if you need a template, we can accept an XLSX or a markdown table.

Best,
Sam

security@cloudcorp.com

Hi Sam — thanks for the patience. Attached is a compact deliverable set intended to address the initial scope you flagged (DATA/CRY/IDNT):

- caiq-answers-v1.2.xlsx: one-sheet resolution matrix, short responses (Y/Partial/NA), artifact filename column, and a brief mitigation note where applicable;
- evidence-samples.zip: three sanitized snippets (dataflow diagram png, retention-log-snippet.txt, rbac-excerpt.txt);
- control-resolution-matrix.md: a short narrative explaining redactions and residency behavior.

A few clarifications up-front:
- For DATA-5 (tenant isolation) we included a redacted diagram (no tenant IDs) plus a short note explaining runtime segregation by customer and how Private deployments provide stronger physical separation;
- For CRY (key management), we included a KMS boundary statement and a snippet showing our HSM/KMS rotation cadence; some KMS artifacts for hosted customers are summarized rather than shared to avoid exposing operational keys;
- Residency: where artifacts differ by deployment mode we noted "varies by deployment: hosted / dedicated / private" and attached an appendix item describing available logs by region.

Links / tracking: HubSpot ticket CC-4829 now updated with the attachment list and the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCaiqDeck.

If you'd like a short walk-through (15–20m) to run through any item we can schedule early next week. Otherwise, please confirm receipt and let us know if you want additional redacted samples or an exec summary for your compliance committee.

Best,
